title: Using Autoethnography to aid learning & comprehension as an Aspiring Psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，要是你们能赚取超越“用时间换金钱”的钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年完成过这个项目，此后也一直陪伴着两批心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，且无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南和梅森的甜点，以及限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Hi, today's episode is all about auto-ethnography.
sentences.zh: 嗨，今天的节目是关于自我民族志的。

sentences.en: And you might notice some slight weirdness when I say the word auto-ethnography.
sentences.zh: 当我念出“自我民族志”这个词时，你可能会觉得有点怪异。

sentences.en: Because I got to the end of filming all of it.
sentences.zh: 因为我拍完了所有的内容。

sentences.en: And I got to the end of that day.
sentences.zh: 那天拍摄结束了。

sentences.en: I got to being in bed.
sentences.zh: 我已经躺在床上了。

sentences.en: And I got to being asleep.
sentences.zh: 而且我已经睡着了。

sentences.en: And then suddenly my brain woke me up in the middle of the night to make me wonder whether I had accidentally said ethnography all the way through instead of auto-ethnography.
sentences.zh: 然后突然我的大脑在半夜把我叫醒，让我开始怀疑自己刚才从头到尾是不是不小心把“民族志”说成了“自我民族志”。

sentences.en: And of course, when I listened back to do the editing, I had.
sentences.zh: 当然，当我回听准备剪辑时，确实是这样的。

sentences.en: So I've tried to fix it where I can.
sentences.zh: 所以我已经在能修改的地方尽量修复了。

sentences.en: But, you know, perfectionism, there's no place for it in modern mental health services.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，完美主义，在现代心理健康服务中是没有立足之地的。

sentences.en: And so I have just done the best I can.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是尽力而为了。

sentences.en: Hope this doesn't take away any enjoyment.
sentences.zh: 希望这不会影响大家的收听体验。

sentences.en: But please know that I am referring to auto-ethnography.
sentences.zh: 但请大家知道，我指的是自我民族志。

sentences.en: Hope you find it really useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你们觉得它真的很有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有志心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们的收听。

sentences.en: It means a great deal to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我的意义非常重大。

sentences.en: And I record this at the point where we are at about 2,500 downloads of the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我录制这集的时候，《有志心理学家播客》的下载量大约达到了2500次。

sentences.en: And that just is incredible to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说简直太不可思议了。

sentences.en: You know, I hatched this idea in my kitchen one day as I cooked tea.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有一天我在厨房做晚饭时萌生了这个想法。

sentences.en: And the idea that people are really enjoying it and finding it beneficial and helpful is just, you know, so validating and so wonderful and energizing to me.
sentences.zh: 一想到大家真的很喜欢它，并从中受益、获得帮助，我就觉得特别受肯定、特别美好、也特别让我充满活力。

sentences.en: So, you know, I set out to hope that this would be useful.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我一开始是希望这能派上用场。

sentences.en: And it turns out that it is.
sentences.zh: 事实证明它确实如此。

sentences.en: It's been really nice hearing people's stories about what they are doing and how they are doing it whilst listening.
sentences.zh: 听到大家分享他们在边听边做什么、以及进展如何的故事，感觉真的很棒。

sentences.en: So some people have been in contact to say that I am their running companion or their companion for out walking the dog.
sentences.zh: 所以有些人联系我说，我是他们跑步时的伴侣，或者他们遛狗时的伴侣。

sentences.en: You know, they've got me in their ears as they are out and about.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们在户外活动时，耳朵里听着我的声音。

sentences.en: You know, some people really like to step it up when the jingles come along.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有些人真的很喜欢在片头曲响起时加速。

sentences.en: That's their chance to sprint.
sentences.zh: 那是他们冲刺的机会。

sentences.en: And other people say that even though they're not psychologists, they like listening to this because it really helps them think about mental health.
sentences.zh: 还有人说，尽管他们不是心理学家，但他们很喜欢听这个，因为这真的帮他们思考了心理健康。

sentences.en: It helps them think about how therapy is put together.
sentences.zh: 这帮他们思考治疗是如何构成的。

sentences.en: And also some people say they use me to listen to as they are going off to sleep.
sentences.zh: 也有人说他们习惯听着我的声音入睡。

sentences.en: And I shan't take that too personally.
sentences.zh: 我不会把这当成什么个人冒犯。

sentences.en: But people say that they like my voice, which is just really nice.
sentences.zh: 但大家说他们喜欢我的声音，这真的很好。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你们。

sentences.en: But in the in the in the most part, I believe our our audience are mainly listening, apparently on Spotify.
sentences.zh: 不过总的来说，我相信我们的听众主要是在Spotify上收听的，显然是这样。

sentences.en: But there's lots of other ways you can listen as well.
sentences.zh: 但你也可以通过很多其他方式收听。

sentences.en: So Apple podcasts, Amazon music, Google podcasts.
sentences.zh: 比如苹果播客、亚马逊音乐、谷歌播客。

sentences.en: You can watch on YouTube as well.
sentences.zh: 你还可以在YouTube上观看。

sentences.en: Um, this is, you know, largely helpful for an aspiring psychologist audience.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这对有志成为心理学家的听众来说，（你知道的）在很大程度上是很有帮助的。

sentences.en: And, you know, your feedback is so welcome.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，你们的反馈非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: If you want to get involved with the podcast and you'd like to leave an audio testimonial, either for the podcast itself or for one of my books,
sentences.zh: 如果你想参与到播客中来，并且想留下音频评价，无论是针对播客本身还是针对我的某本书，

sentences.en: then please do check out my website.
sentences.zh: 那么请务必查看我的网站。

sentences.en: There's details in the links section for how you can get involved, how you can download information about how to create your audio testimonial.
sentences.zh: 链接部分有详细信息，告诉你如何参与，以及如何下载关于如何创建你的音频评价的说明。

sentences.en: It could just be your little thank you to me.
sentences.zh: 这可以只是你对我的一个小小的感谢。

sentences.en: If you are enjoying the content, I would so, so welcome it.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在享受这些内容，我会非常、非常欢迎。

sentences.en: I'd be really grateful.
sentences.zh: 我会由衷地感激。

sentences.en: So thank you for that.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你们。

sentences.en: And if you are listening on Apple podcasts, please take just two seconds to scroll down to where the trailer is, um, right at the bottom of all of the episodes and just click rate,
sentences.zh: 如果你是在苹果播客上收听，请花短短两秒钟向下滚动到预告片的位置——嗯，就在所有剧集的的最底部——然后点击评分，

sentences.en: just click rate, rate, um, out of five stars, how much you're enjoying the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 只需点击评分，打个星，评判一下五星中有几星，看看你有多喜欢这个播客。

sentences.en: And if you have one minute more than that, could you maybe leave me a review for the podcast?
sentences.zh: 如果你还能多出一分钟时间，能不能顺便为这个播客留个评论呢？

sentences.en: That would be so appreciated.
sentences.zh: 那将是对我莫大的支持。

sentences.en: Um, and why that is helpful is because, uh, podcasts with more reviews and more ratings get shown to more people and it, it, you know, empowers people to give podcasts a chance.
sentences.zh: 嗯，为什么这很有用呢？因为，呃，拥有更多评论和更多评分的播客会被推荐给更多人，而且它，它，你知道的，能鼓励人们给播客一个机会。

sentences.en: If they can see that other people who might be people just like them are finding it useful.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能看到其他和他们一样的人觉得它很有用的话。

sentences.en: Why do we like what others have got to say?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们喜欢听别人怎么说？

sentences.en: And this is going to be the topic for our podcast today.
sentences.zh: 这将是我们今天播客的主题。

sentences.en: Um, why is it useful to hear how other people have done things and why I know that this is certainly a way that I learn really well from, um, from working with clients,
sentences.zh: 嗯，为什么听别人是怎么做的事情会很有用？我知道这肯定是我从与客户合作中、

sentences.en: but also from reading books.
sentences.zh: 以及从阅读书籍中学到东西的一种极好的方式。

sentences.en: And it is a form of, um, um, literature called auto ethnography is just beautiful.
sentences.zh: 这是文学的一种形式，嗯，嗯，被称为自我民族志，简直太美妙了。

sentences.en: Um, and it's something that I've always been interested in, but I didn't realize that there was like a word for it, a phrase for it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是我一直很感兴趣的东西，但我以前不知道它有一个专门的词、一个短语。

sentences.en: And it's actually only after I published the, um, clinical psychologist collective that I realized that that is what we are doing in the book.
sentences.zh: 实际上，直到我出版了《临床心理学家合集》之后，我才意识到我们在书里做的事就是这个。

sentences.en: So auto ethnography is a way of learning or a way for someone to talk about themselves and their experiences by talking exactly about themselves,
sentences.zh: 所以，自我民族志是一种学习方式，或者说是一个人通过明确地谈论自己，

sentences.en: by talking about their own personal accounts and reflections.
sentences.zh: 通过谈论他们自己的个人经历和反思，来谈论自己及自身经历的方式。

sentences.en: So I guess technically it could be thought of as a, as a type of research, an ethnographical account, um, um, or an ethnographical piece of research.
sentences.zh: 所以我想从技术上讲，它可以被认为是一种研究、一种民族志叙述，嗯，嗯，或者是一篇民族志研究作品。

sentences.en: Um, so perhaps grounded theory, um, strays into ethnographic, um, uh, territory as well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以也许扎根理论，嗯，也涉足了民族志的，嗯，嗯，领域。

sentences.en: Um, but I have always learned really well from being able to hold in mind case stories and case histories.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我一直通过能够在脑海中记住案例故事和病史来学到很多东西。

sentences.en: And so that for me is what is going on in the clinical psychologist collective and in the grief collective.
sentences.zh: 因此对我来说，这就是《临床心理学家合集》和《悲伤合集》中正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: And may this be a little exclusive scoop that you are the first people to hear about this.
sentences.zh: 愿这是一个小小的独家猛料，你们是第一批听到这个消息的人。

sentences.en: There is another book coming because, you know, the clinical psychologist collective is great, um,
sentences.zh: 还有另一本书要出了，因为，你知道的，《临床心理学家合集》很棒，嗯，

sentences.en: if you are already on the path and looking to apply to become a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你已经走在这条路上，并且正准备申请成为一名临床心理学家的话。

sentences.en: But I know that, um, some people are not yet there, you know, you may be listening to this podcast because you are, um, you know,
sentences.zh: 但我知道，嗯，有些人还没到那一步，你知道的，你可能会听这个播客，因为你，嗯，你知道的，

sentences.en: perhaps studying psychology either at university or maybe even college.
sentences.zh: 也许正在大学甚至学院里学习心理学。

sentences.en: I know we've got some, um, um, college and sixth form students listening to, um,
sentences.zh: 我知道我们也有一些，嗯，嗯，学院和预科的学生在听，嗯，

sentences.en: and why this can be really useful is because it can help you think about what your next step job will be or what it could be.
sentences.zh: 为什么这会非常有用呢，因为它可以帮你思考你下一份工作会是什么，或者可能会是什么。

sentences.en: What, um, route to becoming whatever type of qualified psychologist is on your wishlist might be useful for you.
sentences.zh: 你心仪的、成为某种特定类型合格心理学家的路线，对你来说可能是怎样的。

sentences.en: And so the book that is coming, there's a working title for it, um, the aspiring psychologist collective,
sentences.zh: 所以即将出版的那本书，目前有一个暂定书名，嗯，《有志心理学家合集》，

sentences.en: and it is going to include the ethnographic accounts of people who are not yet on clinical training.
sentences.zh: 它将包含那些尚未接受临床培训的人的民族志叙述。

sentences.en: So there might be some stories in there, um, of people who are having interviews for, um, for either educational psychology or clinical psychology, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以里面可能会有一些故事，嗯，关于那些正在参加面试的人，嗯，无论是为了教育心理学还是临床心理学，你知道的，

sentences.en: maybe forensic psychology, um, this year.
sentences.zh: 也许还有法医心理学，嗯，就在今年。

sentences.en: So it's going to be a really current finger on the pulse kind of book, you know, I'm hoping to have it published, um,
sentences.zh: 所以这将是一本非常紧跟潮流、把握脉搏的书，你知道的，我希望能在，嗯，10月份出版，

sentences.en: for October so that we can see out this cycle of certainly clinical applications.
sentences.zh: 这样我们就能看清这一轮临床申请的周期了。

sentences.en: And I am asking for aspiring psychologists who are already on their path to their chosen, um, psychology career to get involved.
sentences.zh: 我正在邀请那些已经走在自己心仪的，嗯，心理学职业道路上的有志心理学家们参与进来。

sentences.en: Um, so at this point in time, I'm asking for you to, you know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以在目前这个阶段，我邀请你们，你知道的，

sentences.en: get in contact and show interest in writing and to then submit a few hundred words with a little bit of information about you and what you'd propose to write in your story.
sentences.zh: 与我联系并表达写作兴趣，然后提交几百字的信息，包含关于你的一些情况以及你提议在故事中写些什么。

sentences.en: And then I will be collating those to make sure that we've got a real medley, um, of, um, of stories within the book.
sentences.zh: 然后我会把这些内容整理起来，确保我们在书中有一个真正的，嗯，各种故事的“大杂烩”。

sentences.en: Um, and then if I ask you to write it, um, I would want that back, um, I guess by September.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果我请你来写，嗯，我希望能在，嗯，大概9月份把稿子收回。

sentences.en: So I haven't quite sorted out the dates yet.
sentences.zh: 所以我还没有完全把日期敲定。

sentences.en: This is hot off the press, so I'm going to be working feverishly, um, to get all this sorted.
sentences.zh: 这是最新鲜热乎的爆料，所以我将夜以继日地工作，嗯，把这一切都安排妥当。

sentences.en: So that when this podcast episodes goes live, the details are all there in the show notes, um, for how you can find out more information.
sentences.zh: 以便当这期播客节目上线时，节目文稿里就会有关于你如何了解更多信息的详细说明。

sentences.en: If indeed you would like to, for anyone who, um, has, uh, a story published in the aspiring psychologist collective,
sentences.zh: 如果你确实想参与的话——对于任何，嗯，在《有志心理学家合集》中发表了故事的人，

sentences.en: I will be, um, rewarding you with a paperback copy once it is published.
sentences.zh: 一旦图书出版，我将，嗯，奖励你一本平装版。

sentences.en: That's obviously going to be a lot easier for me to sort out if you are in the UK.
sentences.zh: 如果你在英国，这对我来说显然会更容易处理。

sentences.en: Um, if you're not in the UK, it's perhaps not a deal breaker.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你不在英国，也许这也不是个绝对的绊脚石。

sentences.en: Um, but yeah, I would imagine that because the majority of our audience are UK based, um, that it will be UK based, um, people that are writing stories.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但是是的，我想由于我们的听众绝大多数都在英国，嗯，写故事的人也会是以英国为基地的，嗯，人。

sentences.en: But if you are not UK based and you are still interested in thinking about whether you could, um, add some narratives, add your own ethnographical accounts,
sentences.zh: 但如果你不在英国，却仍然有兴趣考虑是否可以，嗯，添加一些叙事，加入你自己的民族志叙述，

sentences.en: then please do, um, request more information because of course it's relevant and it's, you know,
sentences.zh: 那么请务必，嗯，索取更多信息，因为当然这具有相关性，而且，你知道的，

sentences.en: it's going to be engaging and relatable for people who are then going to buy the book hopefully, um, in future.
sentences.zh: 对于那些希望在将来，嗯，购买这本书的人来说，它将是引人入胜且能引起共鸣的。

sentences.en: Um, and also it's really useful for you to, to do as a reflective account in your own right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，同时，作为你自己的反思性叙述，对你自身而言也非常有用。

sentences.en: So I know when people put together the, their accounts for the grief collective and the clinical psychologist collective,
sentences.zh: 所以，我知道当人们为《悲伤合集》和《临床心理学家合集》撰写叙述时，

sentences.en: they found it a really, you know, fulfilling experience in itself.
sentences.zh: 他们发现这本身就是一段非常、你知道的、充实的经历。

sentences.en: So I hope that you will find that really useful, um, and that you will want to get on board, um, and to kind of get that out there as a dissemination as well, um,
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你会觉得这非常有用，嗯，并且你会想要加入进来，嗯，把它作为一种传播方式展示出去，嗯，

sentences.en: um, as a bit of a publication for you, for your own CV, um, which would be really useful for you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，作为一份为你自己的简历而准备的出版物，这会对你非常有用。

sentences.en: But of course, useful for so many people who want to do what you do one day.
sentences.zh: 当然，对于许多未来想做你现在做的事的人来说，这也同样非常有帮助。

sentences.en: So it might be that you're a research assistant.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能是一名研究助理。

sentences.en: It might be that you're, um, a psychology assistant, an assistant psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 你可能是一名，嗯，心理学助理，助理心理学家。

sentences.en: It might be that you're a psychological wellbeing practitioner.
sentences.zh: 你可能是一名心理健康从业人员。

sentences.en: It might be that you're, you know, a high intensity or low intensity CBT therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 你可能是一名，你知道的，高强度或低强度的CBT治疗师。

sentences.en: It might be that you're doing, you know, um, care assistant work, um, or mental health support worker or, uh, support role work.
sentences.zh: 你可能在从事，你知道的，嗯，护理助理工作，嗯，或者心理健康支持工作者或，呃，支持角色的工作。

sentences.en: So I want to know, you know, and if you've done a few different roles, then I'd like to know about those as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我想知道，你知道的，如果你做过好几个不同的岗位，那我也想了解那些经历。

sentences.en: Um, so yeah, I hope that this sounds really exciting and that you, you are keen to, um, to request more information.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以是的，我希望这听起来非常激动人心，并且你，你很渴望，嗯，索取更多信息。

sentences.en: Let's just take a quick pause here, um, to hear a little bit more about the Clinical Psychologist Collective.
sentences.zh: 现在我们在这里稍作暂停，嗯，来听听更多关于《临床心理学家合集》的内容。

sentences.en: And I will be back shortly so that we can talk more about why and how auto-ethnography is useful to us,
sentences.zh: 我很快就会回来，这样我们就可以更多地讨论为什么以及如何让自我民族志对我们有用，

sentences.en: not only in clinical practice, but also when we're striving for our own goals too.
sentences.zh: 不仅在临床实践中，而且在我们为自己的目标奋斗时也是如此。

sentences.en: The Clinical Psychologist Collective is a fantastic read for aspiring clinical psychologists.
sentences.zh: 《临床心理学家合集》对于有志成为临床心理学家的人来说是一本极佳的读物。

sentences.en: This book provides insights from real trainees and qualified psychologists.
sentences.zh: 这本书提供了来自真实实习生和合格心理学家的真知灼见。

sentences.en: They offer their advice, hope, and encouragement to aspiring clinical psychologists.
sentences.zh: 他们为有志临床心理学家提供了建议、希望和鼓励。

sentences.en: This book helps to put in perspective the variety of journeys people take to become qualified.
sentences.zh: 这本书有助于让人客观地看待人们成为合格心理学家所经历的各种不同旅程。

sentences.en: I would recommend this book to anyone interested in the declinside.
sentences.zh: 我会向任何对……感兴趣的人推荐这本书。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Um, thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢谢你们的收听。

sentences.en: So before the break, we were thinking about what auto-ethnography is.
sentences.zh: 所以在休息之前，我们一直在思考什么是自我民族志。

sentences.en: And now this side of the break, we're going to be thinking about how and why this is useful.
sentences.zh: 现在休息回来后，我们要思考这如何有用以及为什么有用。

sentences.en: And for me, it's about the personal resonance.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这关乎个人的共鸣。

sentences.en: It's about the human story.
sentences.zh: 这关乎人类的故事。

sentences.en: It's about the connection.
sentences.zh: 这关乎连接。

sentences.en: It's also about the, um, well, if they can do it, then so can I.
sentences.zh: 这也关乎，嗯——“既然他们能做到，那我也可以”。

sentences.en: I find it really helps bolster my, um, my faith in myself.
sentences.zh: 我发现这确实有助于增强我，嗯，我对自己信念。

sentences.en: Um, it makes things seem so much more attainable, so much more relatable, because I can then hold in mind those case studies, you know, those examples.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它让事情看起来更加触手可及、更加容易产生共鸣，因为我可以把那些案例研究，你知道的，那些例子，一直记在脑海里。

sentences.en: So when we open up the Clinical Psychologist Collective, the first story you'll read is by Dan.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们翻开《临床心理学家合集》时，你读到的第一个故事是丹写的。

sentences.en: Um, and Dan, um, opens up, um, the beginning of his story by explaining that he got a tutu at university.
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后丹，嗯，在故事的开头解释说他在大学里穿过一件芭蕾舞短裙，以此展开了故事。

sentences.en: Um, and then the story recounts how he has got onto the right track to then be a trainee clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，接着故事讲述了他如何走上正确的轨道，最终成为了一名见习临床心理学家。

sentences.en: So, um, you know, that is really heartening for people to think that actually it is possible.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，你知道的，这对人们来说非常鼓舞人心，让他们觉得实际上这是可能的。

sentences.en: Um, people are holding Dan in mind, um, thinking, well, if Dan can do it, then I can do it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，人们把丹记在心里，嗯，心想“既然丹能做到，那我也能做到”。

sentences.en: It makes it, you know, more tangible, more achievable, more relatable.
sentences.zh: 这让它变得，你知道的，更具体、更能实现、更能让人感同身受。

sentences.en: And I know when I was, um, preparing for interviews, um, either as a qualified or as an aspiring psychologist,
sentences.zh: 我知道自我，嗯，在准备面试时，无论是作为合格的还是作为有志的心理学家，

sentences.en: I would, you know, sit down and try and, um, put down sort of case studies of people that I'd worked with.
sentences.zh: 我都会，你知道的，坐下来并试着，嗯，写下我合作过的那些人的案例研究。

sentences.en: So perhaps from, you know, a psychological perspective of depression, um, perhaps people that I'd worked with, um, with interventions.
sentences.zh: 所以也许从，你知道的，抑郁症的心理学角度出发，嗯，也许是我曾通过干预措施合作过的人。

sentences.en: So, you know, for OCD or, you know, panic, um, and I'd write up case studies, um, about the client and how the,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，针对强迫症或者，你知道的，恐慌，我会写下关于客户的案例研究，嗯，以及，

sentences.en: how it worked well for them and what we did and what we were able to achieve.
sentences.zh: 这对他来说效果如何，我们做了什么，以及我们取得了怎样的成果。

sentences.en: And for me, having those little sort of potted histories, it was then easy for me to be able to draw on that theory and to, to bring it to mind.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，了解那些简短的成长经历小故事，就能让我很轻松地运用这些理论，并在脑海中浮现出来。

sentences.en: And that, for me, again, is what the Grief Collective and what the Clinical Psychologist Collective offers to you.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，这也正是“悲伤集体”和“临床心理学家集体”所能为你提供的东西。

sentences.en: It offers you the chance to have extra stories in your mind to reflect on, to draw upon, to consolidate your own learning and to,
sentences.zh: 它为你提供了在脑海中留下额外故事的机会，让你去反思、去借鉴、去巩固你自己的学习，并且——

sentences.en: to show you that everything and anything is possible.
sentences.zh: 向你展示一切皆有可能，任何事情都有可能发生。

sentences.en: And this is the case for me as well.
sentences.zh: 我这也是一样的。

sentences.en: So coming up, um, in a few weeks time, we've got, uh, another guest interview, um, with a wonderful, uh, researcher, um, and academic, um, book producer.
sentences.zh: 所以在接下来的几周里，嗯，我们将迎来另一位访谈嘉宾，嗯，她是一位非常优秀的，嗯，研究员、学者以及，嗯，图书出版人。

sentences.en: Um, and yeah, I'm not going to tell you who she is, um, but it is going to be an incredibly useful resource.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，我不会告诉你她是谁，嗯，但这将会是一个极其有用的资源。

sentences.en: And for me, um, part of my journey into bookishness and beyond has been holding this lady in mind, you know, she can do it, then I can do it.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，嗯，我成为书虫以及超越自我的旅程的一部分，就是心里一直记着这位女士，你知道的，她能做到，那我也可以做到。

sentences.en: Um, and I want you to be able to take from people in the Clinical Psychologist Collective.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我希望你们能从“临床心理学家集体”的成员身上汲取力量。

sentences.en: I want you to be able to take from the content I create for the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能从我为“有志心理学家播客”创作的内容中汲取力量。

sentences.en: I would love to be part of your inner monologue.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意成为你内心独白的一部分。

sentences.en: Um, it would be an absolute privilege if that was starting to happen for you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果这种事情开始在你身上发生，那将是我的莫大荣幸。

sentences.en: Um, I fully expect that the jingles are already part of your inner daily monologue.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我完全相信，这些旋律已经成为你每天内心独白的一部分了。

sentences.en: Um, are you singing them in the shower?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你洗澡的时候在哼它们吗？

sentences.en: Are you humming them to yourselves as you chop peppers?
sentences.zh: 你切辣椒的时候在心里哼着它们吗？

sentences.en: You know, I do hope so.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我真希望如此。

sentences.en: Um, because yeah, people have been saying they're really liking the jingles, which is just lovely because as you know, I'm a big, big fan.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为没错，人们一直在说他们真的很喜欢这些小调，这真是太棒了，因为如你所知，我是个超级超级粉丝。

sentences.en: But yeah, I would like to be on your team.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我想加入你们的阵营。

sentences.en: Um, one of the good guys in your head that helps you know you can do this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，做你脑海里的好人之一，帮你确信自己能做到这一点。

sentences.en: Um, it might be that some people in the past have told you that you can't or that you shouldn't or that you're bad.
sentences.zh: 嗯，可能过去有人对你说过你做不到，或者你不该这样做，或者你这人很糟。

sentences.en: You know, no good will come from this.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这样做不会有什么好结果。

sentences.en: You should go and do something different.
sentences.zh: 你应该去做点别的。

sentences.en: Um, and it might be useful at this point for me to tell you, um, about some feedback that I received about myself once upon a time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，此时此刻，向你讲讲我曾经收到过的一条关于我自己的反馈，可能会对你有所帮助。

sentences.en: Um, it was actually my grandfather.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其实那是我的祖父说的。

sentences.en: Um, and he said once upon a time, um, Marianne, listening to your voice is one of the most painful experiences of my life.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他曾说过，嗯，“玛丽安，听你的声音是我一生中最痛苦的经历之一。”

sentences.en: Um, and I think I was a bit sort of flabbergasted, really.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我当时真的有点惊呆了，甚至有点不知所措。

sentences.en: Um, I didn't quite know what to say, um, and how to respond.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不太知道该说什么，嗯，该怎么回应。

sentences.en: So I'm not really sure that I did much at all in response to that.
sentences.zh: 所以我不太确定面对那番话我到底做了什么。

sentences.en: Um, I was of course aware that he had been a paramedic in the Second World War.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当然知道他在第二次世界大战中曾是一名急救员。

sentences.en: Um, and so he had seen all sorts of awful things, you know, awful things, trauma.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以他见过各种各样可怕的事情，你知道的，可怕的事情，创伤。

sentences.en: And yet, you know, what a thing to say to someone.
sentences.zh: 然而，你知道的，怎么能对别人说出这样的话呢。

sentences.en: And this was at the point when I was striving to be a psychologist as well.
sentences.zh: 而这正是我当时也正努力成为一名心理学家的时期。

sentences.en: So it really made me think, well, if my voice is that awful, how am I going to make a living out of this?
sentences.zh: 所以这真的让我开始思考，嗯，如果我的声音那么糟糕，我怎么能靠这个谋生呢？

sentences.en: How am I going to have people want to listen to what I've got to say?
sentences.zh: 我怎么能让别人想听我想说的话呢？

sentences.en: And this is why, you know, the feedback from my clients along the journey and the feedback from some of you guys as well.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么，你知道的，一路走来客户给我的反馈，以及你们当中一些人给我的反馈。

sentences.en: That actually you like listening to my voice and that you find it calming and soothing and inspiring.
sentences.zh: 实际上你们喜欢听我的声音，并且觉得它平静、舒缓且具有启发性。

sentences.en: It means a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大。

sentences.en: Um, and actually sometimes I think we can just treat feedback as erroneous.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其实有时候我觉得我们可能会把反馈直接当成是错误的。

sentences.en: You know, not that helpful, kind of so left field that we just don't even need to take it on board.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，没什么帮助，甚至有点匪夷所思，以至于我们根本不需要把它听进去。

sentences.en: You know, people are entitled to their opinion.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，每个人都有权发表自己的意见。

sentences.en: He passed away in 2012.
sentences.zh: 他在2012年去世了。

sentences.en: Um, so I'm never going to know what he, um, what exactly he meant by that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我永远也不会知道他，嗯，他那话到底是什么意思。

sentences.en: Um, but nor do I need to let it trouble me any longer.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我也不需要让它继续困扰我了。

sentences.en: You know, I heard it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我听到了。

sentences.en: I didn't like it.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢它。

sentences.en: Um, I can choose to move on from it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我可以选择从这件事中走出来。

sentences.en: Um, it's not a trauma.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这不是什么创伤。

sentences.en: I can talk about it in a way that is connected, but not distressing, you know, not, not moving me to distress.
sentences.zh: 我可以以一种有连结但又不会感到痛苦的方式来谈论它，你知道的，不会，不会让我感到痛苦。

sentences.en: And, uh, it's been, you know, I never would have imagined that it would be topic for a podcast, but, um, you know, it is.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，这曾经是，你知道的，我绝不会想到它会成为播客的话题，但是，嗯，你知道的，它确实成了。

sentences.en: And in terms of my autobiography, um, you know, it's part of the story, but it's not the whole story and it doesn't need to shape or define me.
sentences.zh: 就我的自传而言，嗯，你知道的，它是故事的一部分，但不是全部，而且它不需要塑造或定义我。

sentences.en: So in the, um, clinical psychologist collective, there is a real flavor, a real diversity of story and of route to becoming either a qualified clinical psychologist,
sentences.zh: 所以在“临床心理学家集体”中，有着真正的特色、丰富多样的故事，以及成为合格临床心理学家的不同途径，

sentences.en: a trainee psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 实习心理学家。

sentences.en: Um, we've also got stories in there from educational psychologist, forensic psychologist, um, health and research psychologist and counseling psychologist as well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们在那里也收集了来自教育心理学家、法医心理学家、嗯，健康与研究心理学家以及咨询心理学家的故事。

sentences.en: Um, because, you know, as we know, the path is not always, um, smooth to clinical, but also clinical is not the only way, you know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为，你知道的，正如我们所知，通往临床的道路并不总是，嗯，一帆风顺的，而且临床也不是唯一的途径，你知道的，

sentences.en: there are absolutely other ways to go on and become a qualified psychologist and to offer your brilliance to the world in a way that might not involve ever going anywhere near being a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 还有绝对其他的方法可以继续成为一名合格的心理学家，并以某种可能完全不需要沾边成为临床心理学家的方式，向世界展现你的才华。

sentences.en: So, um, um, there is so much to learn from others.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，嗯，有太多东西可以向他人学习了。

sentences.en: Um, and I just adore this way of learning about people, um, and, you know, becoming part of their world.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我就是热爱这种了解人们的方式，嗯，你知道的，成为他们世界的一部分。

sentences.en: So, you know, if you've been listening to the podcast for a little while now, um, then hopefully you've enjoyed my little stories.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，如果你听这个播客已经有一小段时间了，嗯，那么希望你喜欢我的小故事。

sentences.en: I know someone said that their favorite bit recently was when I was talking about being a millionaire, feeling like a millionaire as you walked on the carpet with your shoes on.
sentences.zh: 我知道有人说过，他们最近最喜欢的部分是我谈论自己如何成为一个百万富翁，当穿着鞋子走在地毯上时感觉自己像个百万富翁。

sentences.en: Um, but hopefully you like my little anecdotes and, you know, they might just serve you well at a time where you are needing some examples to draw upon a point of pressure.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但希望你喜欢我的小趣闻，你知道的，当你面临压力需要借鉴一些例子时，它们或许就能派上用场。

sentences.en: Um, they might just serve you well when your inner critic chimes in, you know, some of the stuff we've spoken about might rise up for you as a compassionate other to say, actually,
sentences.zh: 嗯，当你的内在批评者插话时，它们或许就能派上用场，你知道的，我们谈论过的一些内容可能会作为一种富有同情心的声音浮现出来，对你说，其实，

sentences.en: that might not be that useful.
sentences.zh: 那可能没那么有用。

sentences.en: Um, so yeah,
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，是的，

sentences.en: what we are doing is important and what is on offer in the clinical psychologist collective and the grief collective is really useful and could really help shape the way that you're thinking about your client work.
sentences.zh: 我们正在做的事情很重要，“临床心理学家集体”和“悲伤集体”提供的内容也非常有用，确实可以帮助塑造你对客户工作的思考方式。

sentences.en: The way that you're thinking about striving for your future goals as well and to help you balance where you are yourself and how that might, um, look for you.
sentences.zh: 以及你对未来目标的追求方式，并帮助你平衡你目前的处境，以及这对你来说，嗯，可能会是怎样的。

sentences.en: You know, you might find it helpful to, um, you know, scribble all over the book if that doesn't break all your book reading rules.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你觉得这不违反你所有的读书规则，你可能会发现在书上乱涂乱画很有帮助。

sentences.en: There's a very few number of books in my life that I've allowed myself to write in, but if I had not put this book together myself, I do believe I would be, um, you know,
sentences.zh: 在我的一生中，只有极少数的书我是允许自己直接在上面写字的，但如果这本书不是我自己整理的，我坚信我会，嗯，你知道的，

sentences.en: highlighting and annotating and adding, you know, those little sticky note things, um,
sentences.zh: 在“临床心理学家集体”的页面上划重点、做批注，还要加上，你知道的，那些小便利贴，嗯，

sentences.en: two pages in the clinical psych collective so that I could draw upon it and so I could put it into themes that resonated with me.
sentences.zh: 这样我就可以从中汲取灵感，并把它整理成与我产生共鸣的主题。

sentences.en: So yeah, do your worst, um, if that doesn't break all your rules about how to look after books.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，尽管大肆涂抹吧，嗯，只要这不违反你关于如何爱护书籍的所有规则。

sentences.en: Um, I hope you found this episode really useful, really thought provoking about what your own ethnography might look like.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我希望你觉得这一期节目非常有用，并且对你自己的民族志可能会是什么样子引发了深刻的思考。

sentences.en: And like I said, if you'd like to get involved with, um, your own story for the aspiring psychologist collective, then do check out the details in the, um,
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，如果你想为“有志心理学家集体”分享你自己的故事，那就去查看，嗯，

sentences.en: show notes for how you can request more information.
sentences.zh: 节目简介中的详细信息，了解如何获取更多信息。

sentences.en: But if you head to my, um, website, which is goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk, um, and then head to my books, there will be information there for you.
sentences.zh: 但是如果你访问我的，嗯，网站，即goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk，嗯，然后查看我的书籍，那里会有相关信息供你参考。

sentences.en: Please do come and connect with me on socials, um, as you might know by now, I am Dr. Marianne Trent on LinkedIn, um, Dr. Marianne Trent on Instagram, Twitter,
sentences.zh: 请务必来社交媒体上与我互动，嗯，正如你现在可能已经知道的那样，我在领英上是Dr. Marianne Trent，嗯，在Instagram和推特上是Dr. Marianne Trent，

sentences.en: I am Good Thinking PS1, and Facebook, um, you can come and grab me on my personal account, um, Marianne Trent, or my business account,
sentences.zh: 我是Good Thinking PS1，在脸书上，嗯，你可以通过我的个人账号，嗯，Marianne Trent，或者我的商业账号来联系我，

sentences.en: which is Good Thinking Psychological Services.
sentences.zh: 也就是Good Thinking Psychological Services。

sentences.en: Um, when there are interview episodes, um, all of them are available, um, to watch on YouTube, but even the audio versions are also available on YouTube too, um,
sentences.zh: 嗯，当有访谈节目时，嗯，所有这些都可以在YouTube上观看，甚至音频版本也可以在YouTube上收听，嗯，

sentences.en: which is Good Thinking Psychological Services.
sentences.zh: 也就是Good Thinking Psychological Services。

sentences.en: Come and subscribe, come and like, and come and comment on an episode.
sentences.zh: 来订阅，来点赞，并在一集节目下留言。

sentences.en: Um, give me your favourite emoji in the comments so that I know that you've been listening and that what we do matters to you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在评论区留下你最喜欢的表情符号，让我知道你一直在听，而且我们做的事情对你来说很重要。

sentences.en: Um, help us spread the word and just, you know, be on my team like I'm on yours because it's so appreciated.
sentences.zh: 嗯，帮我们广而告之，然后，你知道的，加入我的阵营，就像我加入你们的一样，因为这真的很感激。

sentences.en: Looking forward to catching up with you for our next episode very soon.
sentences.zh: 期待很快在下一期节目中与大家交流。

sentences.en: If you are looking for any advice and resources for, um, interview season for psychology, then we have currently, as I record this, got the first, um,
sentences.zh: 如果你正在寻找心理学面试季的任何建议和资源，那么截至我录制时，我们目前已经有了第一个，嗯，

sentences.en: compassionate Q&A available on YouTube for you to watch on replay.
sentences.zh: 充满同情心的答疑环节已在YouTube上线，供你回看。

sentences.en: Um, people found it really useful, um, soothing, calming, validating, inspiring, all of that good stuff.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大家觉得非常有用，嗯，具有舒缓、镇定、肯定、启发的作用，所有这些好东西都有。

sentences.en: So do check that out, um, and I will look forward to catching up with you on our next episode of The Aspiring Psychologist very soon.
sentences.zh: 所以一定要去看看，嗯，我期待很快在“有志心理学家”的下一期节目中与大家交流。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Being well supported during any interview season is so important.
sentences.zh: 在任何面试季都能得到良好的支持是非常重要的。

sentences.en: I have therefore, uh, planned some compassionate question and answer support sessions for you.
sentences.zh: 因此，嗯，我为你计划了一些充满同情心的问答支持环节。

sentences.en: You are absolutely welcome to come along to all of them, some of them, none of them.
sentences.zh: 非常欢迎你参加所有这些环节、部分环节或一个都不参加。

sentences.en: No need to book, and here are the dates for you.
sentences.zh: 无需预约，日期如下。

sentences.en: Monday, the 28th of February from 7.30pm.
sentences.zh: 2月28日星期一晚上7点半。

sentences.en: Monday, the 21st of March, 7.30pm.
sentences.zh: 3月21日星期一晚上7点半。

sentences.en: Monday, the 4th of April, 7.30pm.
sentences.zh: 4月4日星期一晚上7点半。

sentences.en: And Monday, the 9th of May, 7.30pm.
sentences.zh: 以及5月9日星期一晚上7点半。

sentences.en: And they will all be live streaming via my socials, uh, which includes Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Facebook.
sentences.zh: 它们都将通过我的社交媒体进行直播，嗯，包括推特、YouTube、领英和脸书。

sentences.en: So you can absolutely pick your favourite, um, platform.
sentences.zh: 所以你绝对可以选择你最喜欢的，嗯，平台。

sentences.en: And they'll all be available on replay as well.
sentences.zh: 而且它们也都可以进行回看。

sentences.en: Hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得非常有用。

sentences.en: And I will look forward to catching up with some of you then.
sentences.zh: 我期待到时与其中一些人交流。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你能赚取超越“用时间换金钱”的收入，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022, and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的成长之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses, plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利，外加我自己的专属支持套餐，且无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特姆与梅森的精美礼品，以及限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday, the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
